rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately putting items of one kind among items of another.

example.english: We intersperse a few light jokes throughout the talk, and the atmosphere immediately feels less tense.
example.traditional: 我哋喺講座入面穿插幾個輕鬆笑話，氣氛即刻冇咁繃緊。

rows.note: Use this when extra details or items are inserted into an existing text, list, or arrangement.

example.english: The editor decided to intersperse a paragraph of background information into the article.
example.traditional: 編輯喺篇文入面加插咗一段背景資料。
example.jyutping: pin1 cap1 hai2 pin1 man4 jap6 min6 gaa1 caap3 zo2 jat1 dyun6 bui3 ging2 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this when different things are mixed among one another without a clear alternating arrangement.

example.english: This report seems to intersperse quite a few unverified claims with the facts.
example.traditional: 呢篇報道入面夾雜住唔少未經證實嘅消息。
